metadata.purpose: Complete E2E data flow trace for validation and enforcement

content.description: End-to-end data flow from metabob-cli to dashboard with project registration, session linking, SurrealDB persistence, and dashboard queries
content.dataFlow: CLI (register_project) → RPC API (/auth/orgs/{org_id}/projects) → CLI (submit with project_id) → RPC API (/v2/submit) → Celery (run_analysis) → SurrealDB (bulk_create_problems) → Dashboard (list_problems_by_project)

components.currentBehavior: Extracts org_id from JWT token, computes git_root_hash from repo, calls POST /auth/orgs/{org_id}/projects with project metadata (name, repository_url, branch, git_root_hash). Returns project_id for session linking.
components.desiredBehavior: MATCHES IMPLEMENTATION - idempotent project creation with full metadata
components.integration: Called from AnalysisEngine before file submission
components.validationNeeded: E2E test: CLI calls register_project, verifies project created in SurrealDB with correct org_id and metadata

components.currentBehavior: Stores project_id in self._project_id, calls api_client.register_project() before analysis, passes project_id to submit_files()
components.integration: Project ID flows from registration → session → submission
components.validationNeeded: Verify project_id is correctly passed through entire analysis flow

components.currentBehavior: Separate FastAPI router with JWT authentication (get_current_user). POST creates projects with idempotent handling (returns existing if duplicate). GET lists projects with stats (total_sessions, total_activities, total_problems_found/fixed). Protected by org_id verification.
components.validationNeeded: E2E test: Verify CLI can create project, dashboard can retrieve it with stats

components.currentBehavior: CRUD operations for projects table in SurrealDB. Schema: {project_id, org_id, name, git_root_hash, repository_url, branch, settings, stats, created_at, updated_at}. Stats tracking: total_sessions, total_activities, total_problems_found, total_problems_fixed.
components.integration: Used by projects.py router and problem persistence flow
components.validationNeeded: Verify stats are correctly updated when problems are persisted

components.currentBehavior: Accepts project_id as Form parameter. Stores project_id in Redis session: redis.hset(f'session:{session_id}', 'project_id', project_id). Validates session authentication. Submits files to Celery queue.
components.integration: Called by CLI with project_id, project_id persists in Redis for duration of session
components.validationNeeded: E2E test: Verify project_id is stored in Redis session and retrievable by Celery tasks

components.currentBehavior: After storing problems to Redis (7-day TTL), extracts org_id and project_id from Redis session. Calls bulk_create_problems() with schema: {problem_id, session_id, project_id, org_id, file_path, start_line, end_line, category, severity, description, recommendation, context, problem_hash, status, metadata, created_at, updated_at}. Uses async event loop wrapper (_persist_to_surrealdb_sync) to call async operations from sync Celery context. Graceful degradation: logs error but doesn't fail task if SurrealDB write fails.
components.integration: Triggered automatically by run_analysis Celery task after detection model completes
components.validationNeeded: E2E test: Verify problems persist to SurrealDB with correct org_id, project_id, and timestamps after analysis completes

components.currentBehavior: Synchronous wrapper for bulk_create_problems(). Creates new event loop to run async SurrealDB operations from sync Celery worker context. Error handling with logging.
components.validationNeeded: Verify event loop creation/cleanup doesn't leak resources in Celery worker

components.currentBehavior: Bulk insert problems with timestamps. Schema: {problem_id, session_id, project_id, org_id, file_path, start_line, end_line, category, severity, description, recommendation, context, problem_hash, status, metadata, created_at, updated_at}. list_problems_by_project() queries by project_id with ORDER BY created_at DESC for temporal tracking.
components.validationNeeded: E2E test: Verify problems can be queried by project_id with correct temporal ordering

components.component: Dashboard API endpoint for project problems
components.currentBehavior: EXPECTED: REST endpoint that calls list_problems_by_project() with project_id from authenticated user's session. Groups problems by component (file_path). Calculates temporal statistics (problems over time, severity distribution).
components.desiredBehavior: Dashboard can retrieve problems by project_id, grouped by component, with temporal trends
components.integration: Dashboard frontend → Dashboard backend API → problem_ops.list_problems_by_project()
components.validationNeeded: CRITICAL GAP: Need to verify dashboard API endpoint exists and is properly integrated with problem_ops

temporal_tracking.query_support: ORDER BY created_at DESC for temporal trends
